definition: A dedicated section titled "Limitations" (structure and placement)
source_wording: requires all papers to have a clear discussion of limitations, in a dedicated section titled
mapping_note: From calls for papers (EMNLP 2022-23, ARR 2024+).

definition: Discussion of the limitations of the work (content; anywhere in the paper)
source_wording: A1. Did you describe the limitations of your work?

definition: Discussion of potential risks, harms or misuse of the work
source_wording: A2. Did you discuss any potential risks of your work?
mapping_note: Also covers the Ethics FAQ 'Misuse potential' questions (2021-22).

definition: Explicit discussion of ethical issues raised by the paper (ethics / broader impact statement)
source_wording: we ask that you include in the paper an explicit discussion of these issues
mapping_note: From calls for papers; distinct from A2, which asks every paper about risks.

definition: Documentation of co-ordinated disclosure for works describing new vulnerabilities / adversarial techniques
source_wording: The disclosure process must be documented.
mapping_note: ACL Policy on Publication Ethics, section Co-ordinated disclosure (in effect 2025-04-25).

definition: Abstract and introduction summarize the paper's main claims
source_wording: A3. Do the abstract and introduction summarize the paper’s main claims?
mapping_note: Not a reporting requirement in the sense of the project topic; kept for completeness.

definition: Full text of instructions given to participants / annotators
source_wording: D1. Did you report the full text of instructions given to participants
mapping_note: The 2020-23 reproducibility item on new data names annotator instructions only as an example; mapped to DATA_COLLECTION_DESCRIPTION, not here.

definition: How participants were recruited and paid, and whether pay is adequate
source_wording: D2. Did you report information about how you recruited (e.g., crowdsourcing platform, students) and paid participants

definition: Whether and how consent was obtained from people whose data is used
source_wording: D3. Did you discuss whether and how consent was obtained from people whose data you’re using/curating?

definition: Approval (or exemption) of the data collection protocol by an ethics review board (IRB)
source_wording: D4. Was the data collection protocol approved (or determined exempt) by an ethics review board?

definition: Basic demographic and geographic characteristics of the annotators
source_wording: D5. Did you report the basic demographic and geographic characteristics of the annotator population

definition: Creators of used artifacts (code, data, models) are cited
source_wording: B1. Did you cite the creators of artifacts you used?

definition: License or terms of use / distribution of artifacts are discussed
source_wording: B2. Did you discuss the license or terms for use and / or distribution of any artifacts?

definition: Use of existing artifacts is consistent with their intended use; intended use of created artifacts is specified
source_wording: B3. Did you discuss if your use of existing artifact(s) was consistent with their intended use
mapping_note: The Ethics FAQ 'Intended use' question (2021-22) is about the technology, not artifacts: counted under RISKS context, not here.

definition: Steps to check data for personal identifiers or offensive content and to protect / anonymize it
source_wording: B4. Did you discuss the steps taken to check whether the data that was collected / used contains any information that names or uniquely identifies individual people or offensive content

definition: Documentation of artifacts: domains, languages, linguistic phenomena, demographic groups
source_wording: B5. Did you provide documentation of the artifacts, e.g., coverage of domains, languages, and linguistic phenomena, demographic groups represented, etc.?
mapping_note: The 2021-23 item 'Relevant details such as languages, and number of examples and label distributions' is mapped to both B5 (languages) and B6 (counts).

definition: Dataset statistics such as number of examples and train / validation / test splits
repro_checklist_item: Relevant statistics such as number of examples; Details of train/validation/test splits
source_wording: B6. Did you report relevant statistics like the number of examples, details of train / test / dev splits, etc. for the data that you used / created?
mapping_note: Two 2020-21 items (counts, splits) merged: B6 asks for both in one question.

definition: Description of the collection process for new data (e.g. annotator instructions, quality control)
repro_checklist_item: For new data collected, a complete description of the data collection process
source_wording: For new data collected, a complete description of the data collection process

definition: Clear description of the mathematical setting / algorithm / model
repro_checklist_item: A clear description of the mathematical setting, algorithm, and/or model
source_wording: A clear description of the mathematical setting, algorithm, and/or model
mapping_note: No ARR checklist question; the ARR CFP only has a placement rule for model specifications (kept as none).

definition: Source code (link or archive) with dependencies
repro_checklist_item: A link to a downloadable source code, with specification of all dependencies
source_wording: A link to a downloadable source code, with specification of all dependencies

definition: Downloadable version (link or archive) of the data
repro_checklist_item: A link to a downloadable version of the data
source_wording: A link to a downloadable version of the data

definition: Excluded data and pre-processing steps
repro_checklist_item: Explanation of any data that were excluded, and all pre-processing steps
source_wording: Explanation of any data that were excluded, and all pre-processing steps
mapping_note: Mapped to the C2 guidance text ('how data was preprocessed'); guidance under a question counts as part of it.

definition: Description of the computing infrastructure used
source_wording: Description of computing infrastructure used
mapping_note: C1 is split into three requirements (parameters, budget, infrastructure).

definition: Average runtime per model / approach (or estimated energy cost)
source_wording: Average runtime for each approach
mapping_note: Split from C1 budget: per-run runtime is not the total budget over all experiments.

definition: Total computational budget over all experiments (e.g. GPU hours) or energy requirement
source_wording: the total computational budget (e.g., GPU hours)
mapping_note: Includes the Ethics FAQ request to estimate the energy requirement of all experiments (2021-22).

definition: Number of parameters of the models used
repro_checklist_item: Number of parameters in each model
source_wording: Number of parameters in each model

definition: Validation performance corresponding to each reported test result
repro_checklist_item: Corresponding validation performance for each reported test result
source_wording: Corresponding validation performance for each reported test result
mapping_note: Mapped to the C3 guidance text ('be sure to report a result of the same model on the validation set').

definition: Explanation of evaluation metrics (with code)
repro_checklist_item: Explanation of evaluation metrics used, with links to code
source_wording: Explanation of evaluation metrics used, with links to code
mapping_note: C4 (settings of evaluation packages) overlaps only partly; not mapped.

definition: Experimental setup incl. hyperparameter search (bounds, trials, selection method) and best values
repro_checklist_item: Bounds; best configurations; number of trials; selection method
source_wording: C2. Did you discuss the experimental setup, including hyperparameter search and best-found hyperparameter values?
mapping_note: Four 2020-21 hyperparameter items merged (C2 covers search and best values). C2 is also the source of DATA_PREPROCESSING.

definition: Expected validation performance / mean and variance as a function of hyperparameter trials
source_wording: Expected validation performance, as introduced in Section 3.1
mapping_note: Split from RESULT_STATISTICS: variance over hyperparameter trials, 2020 only.

definition: Descriptive statistics of results (number of runs; mean, variance, error bars; max vs mean vs single run)
source_wording: C3. Did you report descriptive statistics about your results
mapping_note: Summary statistics and number of runs (2021-23 reproducibility items) and C3.

definition: Implementation, model and parameter settings of existing packages used (e.g. NLTK, ROUGE)
source_wording: did you report the implementation, model, and parameter settings used

definition: Disclosure of the use of AI assistants in the submission checklist
source_wording: information about your use
mapping_note: E1 wording changes in 2026 ('If you used any AI assistants, ...').

definition: Disclosure of the use and scope of AI writing / coding assistance in the paper itself (e.g. Acknowledgements)
source_wording: should instead be fully disclosed in the Acknowledgements section
